## Evidence boundary
This assessment uses only the tender and supplied HR records. It does not infer statutory PF/ESI thresholds because the tender provides none. The 12-month deployment must be evidenced before the 18 September 2026 16:00 IST deadline; Asha is scheduled for the mandatory 14 September 2026 11:00 IST site visit.

## Manpower matrix
| Role/person group | Required | Supplied evidence | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Project Manager — Asha | 1 Project Manager; degree; 7 years | Degree verified; 8 years verified | READY |
| Engineers — Imran, Neha, Jose | Field Engineers; diploma; 3 years | Three diplomas and 4 years each verified | READY for 3 slots |
| Engineer — Ravi | Fourth engineer; diploma; 3 years | 5 years verified; Ravi's diploma is not present | BLOCKED |
| Technicians — six evidenced | ITI; 2 years | ITI and 3-year letters verified | READY for 6 slots |
| Technicians — Tina and Dev | ITI; 2 years | ITI verified; Tina and Dev have no experience letters | BLOCKED |
| All 13 proposed staff | PF/ESI and background records | August 2026 PF record present; other gaps below | CONDITIONAL |

## Statutory records
The August 2026 PF contribution record covers all 13 proposed staff, but current legal applicability and remittance acceptance still require authorised verification. No ESI contribution record is supplied, so ESI compliance is NOT VERIFIED. The tender states no employee-count or wage threshold; never invent PF or ESI thresholds. Background verification is complete for Asha and four Field Engineers, while technician background-verification status is not supplied.

## Deployment and gap plan
Before bid freeze: obtain and verify Ravi's diploma; obtain Tina and Dev's qualifying experience letters or replace them with evidenced technicians; obtain and validate the required ESI record; complete/evidence technician background checks; and nominate vetted backups. No named backup is supplied, so the 7 days replacement commitment lacks an evidenced succession plan. Maintain 1 Project Manager, 4 Field Engineers, and 8 Technicians across all 12 months, with attendance, substitution, PF/ESI, and credential records reviewed monthly.

## Readiness verdict
CONDITIONAL — not ready for unconditional submission. Resolve and independently verify all credential, ESI, background-check, and backup gaps before authorised HR/legal approval. Do not claim all credentials or statutory compliance are verified from the current records.
